verses.sloka: सारणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रावणम् राक्षस अधिपम् ।बलम् आलोकयन् सर्वम् शुको वाक्यम् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥६-२८-१॥।।
verses.transliteration: sāraṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā rāvaṇam rākṣasa adhipam ।balam ālokayan sarvam śuko vākyam atha abravīt ॥6-28-1॥।।

translations.english: Then Ravana the king of Rakshasas having heard Saarana's words and described the strength (of Vanaras) Suka spoke these words.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्ड का सत्ताइसवाँ सगे पूरा हुआ विं £ अधष्टाविशः संगः सारणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रावणं राच्चसाथिपम्‌ । बलमादिश्य तत्सव शुक्रो वक्यमथात्रवीत्‌

verses.sloka: स्थितान् पश्यसि यान् एतान् मत्तान् इव महाद्विपान् ।न्यग्रोधान् इव गान्गेयान् सालान् हैमवतीन् इव ॥६-२८-२॥।।
verses.transliteration: sthitān paśyasi yān etān mattān iva mahādvipān ।nyagrodhān iva gāngeyān sālān haimavatīn iva ॥6-28-2॥।।

translations.english: "O King! like a banyan tree on the island, like Sala trees on the Himalayan Mountain these people are stationed. You may see them marching. They are strong to encounter, can change form at their free will. They look like gods and Danavas in war and have the valour of gods."
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! a जिन वानरों को मतबाले गजराजों, गङ्गा- तटवतां बटवृक्षो, हिमालयस्थित शालवृक्षों की तरह खड़े हुए देख रहे हें

verses.sloka: एते दुष्प्रसहा राजन् बलिनः काम रूपिणः ।दैत्य दानव सम्काशा युद्धे देव पराक्रमाः ॥६-२८-३॥।।
verses.transliteration: ete duṣprasahā rājan balinaḥ kāma rūpiṇaḥ ।daitya dānava samkāśā yuddhe deva parākramāḥ ॥6-28-3॥।।

translations.english: "O King! like a banyan tree on the island, like Sala trees on the Himalayan Mountain these people are stationed. You may see them marching. They are strong to encounter, can change form at their free will. They look like gods and Danavas in war and have the valour of gods."
translations.hindi: ये सब के सत्र दुर्धध, बलवान और इच्छा-रूपधारी हैं और दृत्यदानवॉको तरह बलसम्पन्न तथा युद्ध में देवतओं की तरह पणक्रमी;हें

verses.sloka: एषाम् कोटि सहस्राणि नव पन्च च सप्त च ।तथा शन्ख सहस्राणि तथा वृन्द शतानि च ॥६-२८-४॥।।
verses.transliteration: eṣām koṭi sahasrāṇi nava panca ca sapta ca ।tathā śankha sahasrāṇi tathā vṛnda śatāni ca ॥6-28-4॥।।

translations.english: "These Vanaras are nine, five and seven thousand crores in number. They are in many thousands of Sankhas and Vrindas."

verses.sloka: एते सुग्रीव सचिवाः किष्किन्धा निलयाः सदा ।हरयो देव गन्धर्वैर् उत्पन्नाः काम रूपिणः ॥६-२८-५॥।।
verses.transliteration: ete sugrīva sacivāḥ kiṣkindhā nilayāḥ sadā ।harayo deva gandharvair utpannāḥ kāma rūpiṇaḥ ॥6-28-5॥।।

translations.english: "These are allies of Sugriva ever residing at Kishkinda. They are born to celestial gods and Gandharvas and can change their form at their will."
translations.hindi: ये सब सुग्रीव के सहायक हैं और किष्किन्धा मेर हा करते हैं । इन वानरों की उप्पत्ति, गन्धो से है और ये इच्छानुसार रुप धारण करने वाले हैं

verses.sloka: यौ तौ पश्यसि तिष्ठन्तौ कुमारौ देव रूपिणौ ।मैन्दः च द्विविदः च उभौ ताभ्याम् न अस्ति समो युधि ॥६-२८-६॥।।
verses.transliteration: yau tau paśyasi tiṣṭhantau kumārau deva rūpiṇau ।maindaḥ ca dvividaḥ ca ubhau tābhyām na asti samo yudhi ॥6-28-6॥।।

translations.english: "Do you see two of them standing there? They are young and have the form of gods. They are Mainda and Dwivida. Both of them are similar in war and none equal them in war."
translations.hindi: सुग्रीवसचिवाः-सुग्रीवसहायाः । ( गो० ) २ कुमारौ-युवानौ । २४२ युद्धकाण्डे आप जिन देवताओं के समान रूपवान्‌ दो युवकों को बैठा हुआ देख रहे हैं, वे दोनों मेन्द और द्विविद हें । युद में उन दोनों का सामना करने वाला कोई नहीं हे

verses.sloka: ब्रह्मणा समनुज्ञाताव् अमृत प्राशिनाव् उभौ ।आशम्सेते युधा लंकाम् एतौ मर्दितुम् ओजसा ॥६-२८-७॥।।
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇā samanujñātāv amṛta prāśināv ubhau ।āśamsete yudhā laṁkām etau marditum ojasā ॥6-28-7॥।।

translations.english: "They drank the nectar of immortality with the permission of Brahma. These leaders are aspiring to destroy Lanka by their prowess."
translations.hindi: क्योंकि ब्रह्मा की आज्ञा से. इन दोनों ने अस्त पान ला हे ये दोनों अपने पराक्रम से लङ्का को ध्वस्त करना चहते हैं

verses.sloka: यम् तु पश्यसि तिष्ठन्तम् प्रभिन्नम् इव कुन्जरम् ।यो बलात् क्षोभयेत् क्रुद्धः समुद्रम् अपि वानरः ॥६-२८-८॥।।
verses.transliteration: yam tu paśyasi tiṣṭhantam prabhinnam iva kunjaram ।yo balāt kṣobhayet kruddhaḥ samudram api vānaraḥ ॥6-28-8॥।।

translations.english: "O Lord! You may see the one standing there like an elephant who can churn up the sea when he is angry. He has come to Lanka earlier, seen Sita and gone back. You may see that he has come again."

verses.sloka: एषो अभिगन्ता लंकाया वैदेह्यास् तव च प्रभो ।एनम् पश्य पुरा दृष्टम् वानरम् पुनर् आगतम् ॥६-२८-९॥।।
verses.transliteration: eṣo abhigantā laṁkāyā vaidehyās tava ca prabho ।enam paśya purā dṛṣṭam vānaram punar āgatam ॥6-28-9॥।।

translations.english: "O Lord! You may see the one standing there like an elephant who can churn up the sea when he is angry. He has come to Lanka earlier, seen Sita and gone back. You may see that he has come again."

verses.sloka: ज्येष्ठः केसरिणः पुत्रो वात आत्मज इति श्रुतः ।हनूमान् इति विख्यातो लन्घितो येन सागरः ॥६-२८-१०॥।।
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhaḥ kesariṇaḥ putro vāta ātmaja iti śrutaḥ ।hanūmān iti vikhyāto langhito yena sāgaraḥ ॥6-28-10॥।।

translations.english: "He is the eldest son born of Kesari and the son of WindGod and is popularly known as Hanuman. He leapt over the sea and came."

verses.sloka: काम रूपी हरि श्रेष्ठो बल रूप समन्वितः ।अनिवार्य गतिः चैव यथा सततगः प्रभुः ॥६-२८-११॥।।
verses.transliteration: kāma rūpī hari śreṣṭho bala rūpa samanvitaḥ ।anivārya gatiḥ caiva yathā satatagaḥ prabhuḥ ॥6-28-11॥।।

translations.english: "He is a jewel among Vanaras. He can change his form at his will. He is endowed with physical strength and charm. Being existent everywhere like windgod his cause cannot be prevented like that of wind god."
translations.hindi: हो पेट अष्टावशाः सँग: २४२ सो इसे आप पहिले देख ही चुके हैं, वद्दी फिर आयां है! यह केसरी का श्रेष्ठ पुत्र हे और वातात्मन अथात्‌ वाउउद्र के नाम से प्रतिद्व हे

verses.sloka: उद्यन्तम् भास्करम् दृष्ट्वा बालः किल पिपासितः ।त्रियोजन सहस्रम् तु अध्वानम् अवतीर्य हि ॥६-२८-१२॥।।
verses.transliteration: udyantam bhāskaram dṛṣṭvā bālaḥ kila pipāsitaḥ ।triyojana sahasram tu adhvānam avatīrya hi ॥6-28-12॥।।

translations.english: When he was a child, on seeing the rising Sun, he travelled three thousand yojanas and said, "I will eat up the Sun otherwise I will not be appeased', being proud of his strength."
translations.hindi: इसक १ नाम है. और इसीने समुद्र लाचा था। यह ७ कक का कर लेता है, वानरों में श्रेष्ठ है. ओर बड़ा बलवान्‌ है

verses.sloka: आदित्यम् आहरिष्यामि न मे क्षुत् प्रतियास्यति ।इति सम्चिन्त्य मनसा पुरा एष बल दर्पितः ॥६-२८-१३॥।।
verses.transliteration: ādityam āhariṣyāmi na me kṣut pratiyāsyati ।iti samcintya manasā purā eṣa bala darpitaḥ ॥6-28-13॥।।

translations.english: When he was a child, on seeing the rising Sun, he travelled three thousand yojanas and said, "I will eat up the Sun otherwise I will not be appeased', being proud of his strength."

verses.sloka: अनाधृष्यतमम् देवम् अपि देव ऋषि दानवैः ।अनासाद्य एव पतितो भास्कर उदयने गिरौ ॥६-२८-१४॥।।
verses.transliteration: anādhṛṣyatamam devam api deva ṛṣi dānavaiḥ ।anāsādya eva patito bhāskara udayane girau ॥6-28-14॥।।

translations.english: "Unassailable even for gods, sages and Danavas to reach the Sun god, he fell down near the eastern part."
translations.hindi: शि वायु की तरह इसकी गति कहीं भी नहीं रुकती, लड़कपन ५ एक दिन इसे भूख लगी । उस समय सूर्य उद्य हो रहा था ॥१३ A Ce त्रियोजनसहस्र तु अध्वानमबताय हि । आदित्यमाहरिष्यामि न मे क्षुत्ततियास्यति

verses.sloka: पतितस्य कपेर् अस्य हनुर् एका शिला तले ।किम्चिद् भिन्ना दृढ हनोर् हनूमान् एष तेन वै ॥६-२८-१५॥।।
verses.transliteration: patitasya kaper asya hanur ekā śilā tale ।kimcid bhinnā dṛḍha hanor hanūmān eṣa tena vai ॥6-28-15॥।।

translations.english: "By falling on the mountain one of the jaws of the monkey got broken. This is the reason that he is known as Hanuman."

verses.sloka: सत्यम् आगम योगेन मम एष विदितो हरिः ।न अस्य शक्यम् बलम् रूपम् प्रभावो वा अनुभाषितुम् ॥६-२८-१६॥।।
verses.transliteration: satyam āgama yogena mama eṣa vidito hariḥ ।na asya śakyam balam rūpam prabhāvo vā anubhāṣitum ॥6-28-16॥।।

translations.english: "I came to know about him through one of my contacts. His strength, his appearance and glory are indescribable."

verses.sloka: एष आशम्सते लंकाम् एको मर्दितुम् ओजसा ।येव जाज्वल्यतेऽसौ वै धूमकेतुस्तवाद्य वै ॥६-२८-१७॥।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa āśamsate laṁkām eko marditum ojasā ।yeva jājvalyate'sau vai dhūmaketustavādya vai ॥6-28-17॥।।

translations.english: "This monkey is intending to demolish this Lanka single handed. How can you forget about (the task of) setting his tail on fire entrusted by you to Dhoomakethu?"
translations.hindi: थोड़ी सी टूट गई । क्‍योंकि ठोड़ी इसको बड़ी मजबूत थी, ख इसका नाम हनुमान हुआ । वानरों के सहवास से यद्यपि स॑ने इस वानर का यह हाल जान लिआ हे

verses.sloka: लंकायाम् निहितश्चापि कथम् विस्मरसे कसिम् ।यः च एषो अनन्तरः शूरः श्यामः पद्म निभ ईक्षणः ॥६-२८-१८॥।।
verses.transliteration: laṁkāyām nihitaścāpi katham vismarase kasim ।yaḥ ca eṣo anantaraḥ śūraḥ śyāmaḥ padma nibha īkṣaṇaḥ ॥6-28-18॥।।

translations.english: "O king! the king who is not distant from him, a dark complexioned, one with lotus eyes who never transgresses his righteousness, who is a great charioteer of Ikshvaku race who knows use of Vedas, who is choicest, who knows the weapons presided over by Brahma whose arrows can pierce through the sky and even mountains whose anger is like anger of death, whose valour is like that of Indra whose consort has been borne away from Janasthana is Rama. He is advancing towards you to wage war with you."
translations.hindi: „चास्य शक्यं बलं रूपं प्रभावो वाऽपि भाषितुम्‌ । एष आशंसते लङ्कामेको मदितुमोजसा ॥ १८. तथापि मैं इसका वल, रूप और प्रभाव वणन नहीं कर सकता" यह अकेला, अपने बल ही से लङ्का को ध्वस्त करना चाहता है

verses.sloka: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् अतिरथो लोके विख्यात पौरुषः ।यस्मिन् न चलते धर्मो यो धर्मम् न अतिवर्तते ॥६-२८-१९॥।।
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākūṇām atiratho loke vikhyāta pauruṣaḥ ।yasmin na calate dharmo yo dharmam na ativartate ॥6-28-19॥।।

translations.english: "O king! the king who is not distant from him, a dark complexioned, one with lotus eyes who never transgresses his righteousness, who is a great charioteer of Ikshvaku race who knows use of Vedas, who is choicest, who knows the weapons presided over by Brahma whose arrows can pierce through the sky and even mountains whose anger is like anger of death, whose valour is like that of Indra whose consort has been borne away from Janasthana is Rama. He is advancing towards you to wage war with you."

verses.sloka: यो ब्राह्मम् अस्त्रम् वेदामः च वेद वेदविदाम् वरः ।यो भिन्द्याद् गगनम् बाणैः पर्वतामः च अपि दारयेत् ॥६-२८-२०॥।।
verses.transliteration: yo brāhmam astram vedāmaḥ ca veda vedavidām varaḥ ।yo bhindyād gaganam bāṇaiḥ parvatāmaḥ ca api dārayet ॥6-28-20॥।।

translations.english: "O king! the king who is not distant from him, a dark complexioned, one with lotus eyes who never transgresses his righteousness, who is a great charioteer of Ikshvaku race who knows use of Vedas, who is choicest, who knows the weapons presided over by Brahma whose arrows can pierce through the sky and even mountains whose anger is like anger of death, whose valour is like that of Indra whose consort has been borne away from Janasthana is Rama. He is advancing towards you to wage war with you."
translations.hindi: धूमकेतुरग्निः | ( रा० ) अ पाठान्तरे--“जाज्वल्यते उसौवे ? श्रष्टाविशः सग; २४५ हनुमान के पास ही जो शूर श्यामवण्‌, कमलनयन, इक्ष्वाकु कुल में अजेय योद्धा और संसार में विख्यात पराक्रमी हैं

verses.sloka: यस्य मृत्योर् इव क्रोधः शक्रस्य इव पराक्रमः ।यस्य भार्या जन्स्थानात्सीता चापि हृता त्वया ॥६-२८-२१॥।।
verses.transliteration: yasya mṛtyor iva krodhaḥ śakrasya iva parākramaḥ ।yasya bhāryā jansthānātsītā cāpi hṛtā tvayā ॥6-28-21॥।।

translations.english: "O king! the king who is not distant from him, a dark complexioned, one with lotus eyes who never transgresses his righteousness, who is a great charioteer of Ikshvaku race who knows use of Vedas, who is choicest, who knows the weapons presided over by Brahma whose arrows can pierce through the sky and even mountains whose anger is like anger of death, whose valour is like that of Indra whose consort has been borne away from Janasthana is Rama. He is advancing towards you to wage war with you."
translations.hindi: जो धर्म से तो कभी डिगते हैं और न धम की मर्यादा को उल्लड्कन ही करते हैं, जो त्रह्माख का चलाना जानते हैं, जो वेदों को केबल जानते ही नहीं, बल्कि वेदवेत्ताओं में श्रेष्ठ माने जाते हैं

verses.sloka: स एष रामस् त्वाम् योद्धुम् राजन् समभिवर्तते ।यः च एष दक्षिणे पार्श्वे शुद्ध जाम्बू नद प्रभः ॥६-२८-२२॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa eṣa rāmas tvām yoddhum rājan samabhivartate ।yaḥ ca eṣa dakṣiṇe pārśve śuddha jāmbū nada prabhaḥ ॥6-28-22॥।।

translations.english: "To his right is his brother known as Lakshmana whose body radiates like gold, he has broad chest, red eyes, dark curly hair. He is as dear as his life to Rama. He is skilled in moral science and warfare. He is the foremost and the best among wielders of weapons."
translations.hindi: जो अपने बाणों से आकाश को छेद सकते हे ऑर पंव ता को विदीर्ण कर सकते हैं, जिनका क्रोध, मृत्यु के समान ऑर पराक्रम इन्द्र की तरह दे

verses.sloka: विशाल वक्षास् ताम्र अक्षो नील कुन्चित मूर्धजः ।एषो अस्य लक्ष्मणो नाम भ्राता प्राण समः प्रियः ॥६-२८-२३॥।।
verses.transliteration: viśāla vakṣās tāmra akṣo nīla kuncita mūrdhajaḥ ।eṣo asya lakṣmaṇo nāma bhrātā prāṇa samaḥ priyaḥ ॥6-28-23॥।।

translations.english: "To his right is his brother known as Lakshmana whose body radiates like gold, he has broad chest, red eyes, dark curly hair. He is as dear as his life to Rama. He is skilled in moral science and warfare. He is the foremost and the best among wielders of weapons."
translations.hindi: आर जिनकी खी सीता को तुम जनस्थान से हर लाए हो हे राजन्‌! वे ही श्रीरामचन्द्र तुमसे लड़ने के लिए यहाँ आए हैं

verses.sloka: नये युद्धे च कुशलः सर्व शास्त्रभृताम् वरः ।अमर्षी दुर्जयो जेता विक्रान्तो बुद्धिमान् बली ॥६-२८-२४॥।।
verses.transliteration: naye yuddhe ca kuśalaḥ sarva śāstrabhṛtām varaḥ ।amarṣī durjayo jetā vikrānto buddhimān balī ॥6-28-24॥।।

translations.english: "He is one who does not forgive (Rama's enemies), difficult to win, indomitable, victorious, strong and wise one. He is the right hand of Rama and external breath of his life."

verses.sloka: रामस्य दक्षिणो बाहुर् नित्यम् प्राणो बहिः चरः ।न हि एष राघवस्य अर्थे जीवितम् परिरक्षति ॥६-२८-२५॥।।
verses.transliteration: rāmasya dakṣiṇo bāhur nityam prāṇo bahiḥ caraḥ ।na hi eṣa rāghavasya arthe jīvitam parirakṣati ॥6-28-25॥।।

translations.english: "For the cause of Rama, he will spare his life. He too is intent upon destroying all Rakshasas."
translations.hindi: उनकी दहिनी ओर विशुद्ध सुवण वण जैसे, चौड़ी छाती वाले, अरुणनयन तथा नीले रंग के और घुंघराले बालों से RR क Ee # पाठान्तरे--धमै नातिबतेते ।? PROC el le 0 0 का २४६ युद्धकाण्डे एषोऽस्य लक्ष्मणे नाम आता प्राणसमः प्रियः । नये युद्धे च कुशलः सवंशस्रभृतां वरः

verses.sloka: एष एव आशम्सते युद्धे निहन्तुम् सर्व राक्षसान् ।यस् तु सव्यम् असौ पक्षम् रामस्य आश्रित्य तिष्ठति ॥६-२८-२६॥।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa eva āśamsate yuddhe nihantum sarva rākṣasān ।yas tu savyam asau pakṣam rāmasya āśritya tiṣṭhati ॥6-28-26॥।।

translations.english: "The one who is near Rama's left who sought Rama's refuge and stands surrounded by Rakshasas and protected is the king Vibheeshana."
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का अपचार इनसे नहीं सहा जाता, इनको रण में कोई जीत नहीं सकता । ये सबको जीतने बाले है, ये बड़े पराक्रमी, बुद्धिमान्‌ और बलवान्‌ हे । ये श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की दृहिनी बाँह और उनके प्राणों के संरक्षक हैं

verses.sloka: रक्षो गण परिक्षिप्तो राजा हि एष विभीषणः ।श्रीमता राज राजेन लंकायाम् अभिषेचितः ॥६-२८-२७॥।।
verses.transliteration: rakṣo gaṇa parikṣipto rājā hi eṣa vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।śrīmatā rāja rājena laṁkāyām abhiṣecitaḥ ॥6-28-27॥।।

translations.english: "He is a prosperous king of the kings of Lanka. He has been consecrated by Rama, filled with anger he is advancing to wage war with you."
translations.hindi: ये श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की र्षा के लिए अपने प्राणां को हथेली पर रखे हुए, सदा तैयार रहते हे । युद्ध में ये अकेले ही समस्त राक्षसों को मार डालने का उत्साह रखते हे

verses.sloka: त्वाम् एव प्रतिसम्रब्धो युद्धाय एषो अभिवर्तते ।यम् तु पश्यसि तिष्ठन्तम् मध्ये गिरिम् इव अचलम् ॥६-२८-२८॥।।
verses.transliteration: tvām eva pratisamrabdho yuddhāya eṣo abhivartate ।yam tu paśyasi tiṣṭhantam madhye girim iva acalam ॥6-28-28॥।।

translations.english: "The one whom you see standing in the midst is the king of all chiefs of the Vanara army, a highly glorious one, steady like a mountain. like Himalayas that outshines all mountains, he surpasses all in fame, in intellect, in wisdom and in lineage. That monkey chief resides in the mountain cave fort with thickly grown trees around in the middle of Kishkinda, which is difficult to access, and is surrounded by his army chiefs. See the golden chain on him shining away with hundred lotuses in which stands Lakshmi installed which is difficult even for gods and human beings to covet. In the same way as the golden chain, even his beloved Tara and kingdom of the monkeys was permanently bestowed upon him by Rama after slaying Vali."

verses.sloka: सर्व शाखा मृग इन्द्राणाम् भर्तारम् अपराजितम् ।तेजसा यशसा बुद्ध्या ज्ञानेन अभिजनेन च ॥६-२८-२९॥।।
verses.transliteration: sarva śākhā mṛga indrāṇām bhartāram aparājitam ।tejasā yaśasā buddhyā jñānena abhijanena ca ॥6-28-29॥।।

translations.english: "The one whom you see standing in the midst is the king of all chiefs of the Vanara army, a highly glorious one, steady like a mountain. like Himalayas that outshines all mountains, he surpasses all in fame, in intellect, in wisdom and in lineage. That monkey chief resides in the mountain cave fort with thickly grown trees around in the middle of Kishkinda, which is difficult to access, and is surrounded by his army chiefs. See the golden chain on him shining away with hundred lotuses in which stands Lakshmi installed which is difficult even for gods and human beings to covet. In the same way as the golden chain, even his beloved Tara and kingdom of the monkeys was permanently bestowed upon him by Rama after slaying Vali."

verses.sloka: यः कपीन् अति बभ्राज हिमवान् इव पर्वतान् ।किष्किन्धाम् यः समध्यास्ते गुहाम् सगहन द्रुमाम् ॥६-२८-३०॥।।
verses.transliteration: yaḥ kapīn ati babhrāja himavān iva parvatān ।kiṣkindhām yaḥ samadhyāste guhām sagahana drumām ॥6-28-30॥।।

translations.english: "The one whom you see standing in the midst is the king of all chiefs of the Vanara army, a highly glorious one, steady like a mountain. like Himalayas that outshines all mountains, he surpasses all in fame, in intellect, in wisdom and in lineage. That monkey chief resides in the mountain cave fort with thickly grown trees around in the middle of Kishkinda, which is difficult to access, and is surrounded by his army chiefs. See the golden chain on him shining away with hundred lotuses in which stands Lakshmi installed which is difficult even for gods and human beings to covet. In the same way as the golden chain, even his beloved Tara and kingdom of the monkeys was permanently bestowed upon him by Rama after slaying Vali."
translations.hindi: जिनको आप एक अचल पवत की तरह श्रीरामचन्द्र और विभीषण के बीचमें बैठा हुआ देखते हे, वे ही समस्त वानरों के राजा हैं, इनको पराजित करना .सहूज नहीं

verses.sloka: दुर्गाम् पर्वत दुर्गस्थाम् प्रधानैः सह यूथपैः ।यस्य एषा कान्चनी माला शोभते शत पुष्करा ॥६-२८-३१॥।।
verses.transliteration: durgām parvata durgasthām pradhānaiḥ saha yūthapaiḥ ।yasya eṣā kāncanī mālā śobhate śata puṣkarā ॥6-28-31॥।।

translations.english: "The one whom you see standing in the midst is the king of all chiefs of the Vanara army, a highly glorious one, steady like a mountain. like Himalayas that outshines all mountains, he surpasses all in fame, in intellect, in wisdom and in lineage. That monkey chief resides in the mountain cave fort with thickly grown trees around in the middle of Kishkinda, which is difficult to access, and is surrounded by his army chiefs. See the golden chain on him shining away with hundred lotuses in which stands Lakshmi installed which is difficult even for gods and human beings to covet. In the same way as the golden chain, even his beloved Tara and kingdom of the monkeys was permanently bestowed upon him by Rama after slaying Vali."
translations.hindi: तेजस्विता, यश, ऊहापोहरुपी-ज्ञान, शास्त्रजन्य-ज्ञान तथा, कुल की विशिष्टता के कारण, पवतां में हिमाचल पर्वत की तरह, समस्त वानरों से यह अधिक शोभा पा रहा है

verses.sloka: कान्ता देव मनुष्याणाम् यस्याम् लक्ष्मीः प्रतिष्ठिता ।एताम् च मालाम् ताराम् च कपि राज्यम् च शाश्वतम् ॥६-२८-३२॥।।
verses.transliteration: kāntā deva manuṣyāṇām yasyām lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhitā ।etām ca mālām tārām ca kapi rājyam ca śāśvatam ॥6-28-32॥।।

translations.english: "The one whom you see standing in the midst is the king of all chiefs of the Vanara army, a highly glorious one, steady like a mountain. like Himalayas that outshines all mountains, he surpasses all in fame, in intellect, in wisdom and in lineage. That monkey chief resides in the mountain cave fort with thickly grown trees around in the middle of Kishkinda, which is difficult to access, and is surrounded by his army chiefs. See the golden chain on him shining away with hundred lotuses in which stands Lakshmi installed which is difficult even for gods and human beings to covet. In the same way as the golden chain, even his beloved Tara and kingdom of the monkeys was permanently bestowed upon him by Rama after slaying Vali."
translations.hindi: दे राजन्‌ ! यह वानरराज, वानर यूथपतियाँ के साथ किष्कि- न्धा में एक ऐसी गिरगुहा में , रहते हैं, जो सघन वृक्षा से आच्छादित है और जहाँ पहुँचना बड़ा कठिन है

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवो वालिनम् हत्वा रामेण प्रतिपादितः ।शतम् शतसहस्राणाम् कोटिमाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥६-२८-३३॥।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvo vālinam hatvā rāmeṇa pratipāditaḥ ।śatam śatasahasrāṇām koṭimāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥6-28-33॥।।

translations.english: "It is said by wise men that hundred thousand crores multiplied by hundred thousand crores as Sankha."
translations.hindi: देवताओं और मनुष्यां की बाञ्छनोय लक्ष्मी जिसमें सदा बास करती हैं, वह शतपद्या सोने की माला कपिराज के गले में कैसी शोभित हो रही है

verses.sloka: शतम् कोटिसहस्राणाम् शङ्कुरित्यभिधीयते ।शतम् शङ्कुसहस्राणाम् महाशङ्कुरिति स्मृतः ॥६-२८-३४॥।।
verses.transliteration: śatam koṭisahasrāṇām śaṅkurityabhidhīyate ।śatam śaṅkusahasrāṇām mahāśaṅkuriti smṛtaḥ ॥6-28-34॥।।

translations.english: A lakh of Sanku is known as Maha Sanku. A lakh of Maha Shanka is spoken as Vrinda. A lakh of Vrindas is spoken as Maha Brinda. A lakh of Maha Vrindas is known as Padma. One lakh Padmas is known as Maha Padma and a lakh of Maha Padmas is known as Kharva. A lakh of Kharvas is known as Maha Kharva and a lakh of Maha Kharvas is known as a Samudra. A lakh of Samudras is known as an Ogha. A lakh of Oghas is popularly known as Maha Ogha.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने यह माला, तारा और वानरं का सनातन ( प्राचीन ) राज्य बाली को मार कर इस सुग्रीव को दिलाया है

verses.sloka: महाशङ्क्य्सहस्राणाम् शतम् वृन्दमिहोच्यते ।शतम् नृन्दसहस्राणाम् महावृन्दमिति स्मृतम् ॥६-२८-३५॥।।
verses.transliteration: mahāśaṅkysahasrāṇām śatam vṛndamihocyate ।śatam nṛndasahasrāṇām mahāvṛndamiti smṛtam ॥6-28-35॥।।

translations.english: A lakh of Sanku is known as Maha Sanku. A lakh of Maha Shanka is spoken as Vrinda. A lakh of Vrindas is spoken as Maha Brinda. A lakh of Maha Vrindas is known as Padma. One lakh Padmas is known as Maha Padma and a lakh of Maha Padmas is known as Kharva. A lakh of Kharvas is known as Maha Kharva and a lakh of Maha Kharvas is known as a Samudra. A lakh of Samudras is known as an Ogha. A lakh of Oghas is popularly known as Maha Ogha.

verses.sloka: महावृन्दसहस्राणाम् शतम् पद्ममिहोच्यते ।शतम् पद्मसहस्राणाम् महापद्ममिति स्मृतम् ॥६-२८-३६॥।।
verses.transliteration: mahāvṛndasahasrāṇām śatam padmamihocyate ।śatam padmasahasrāṇām mahāpadmamiti smṛtam ॥6-28-36॥।।

translations.english: A lakh of Sanku is known as Maha Sanku. A lakh of Maha Shanka is spoken as Vrinda. A lakh of Vrindas is spoken as Maha Brinda. A lakh of Maha Vrindas is known as Padma. One lakh Padmas is known as Maha Padma and a lakh of Maha Padmas is known as Kharva. A lakh of Kharvas is known as Maha Kharva and a lakh of Maha Kharvas is known as a Samudra. A lakh of Samudras is known as an Ogha. A lakh of Oghas is popularly known as Maha Ogha.
translations.hindi: सौ हजार शक्ठ का एक महाशङ्घ होता है । सौ हजार महा- शङ्क का एक इन्द होता है

verses.sloka: महापद्मसहस्राणाम् शतम् खर्वमिहोच्यते ।शतम् खर्वसहस्राणाम् महाखर्वमिति स्मृतम् ॥६-२८-३७॥।।
verses.transliteration: mahāpadmasahasrāṇām śatam kharvamihocyate ।śatam kharvasahasrāṇām mahākharvamiti smṛtam ॥6-28-37॥।।

translations.english: A lakh of Sanku is known as Maha Sanku. A lakh of Maha Shanka is spoken as Vrinda. A lakh of Vrindas is spoken as Maha Brinda. A lakh of Maha Vrindas is known as Padma. One lakh Padmas is known as Maha Padma and a lakh of Maha Padmas is known as Kharva. A lakh of Kharvas is known as Maha Kharva and a lakh of Maha Kharvas is known as a Samudra. A lakh of Samudras is known as an Ogha. A lakh of Oghas is popularly known as Maha Ogha.
translations.hindi: सौ हजार वृन्द का एक महावृन्द होता है । सौ हजार महा- « बृन्द का एक पद्म होता है

verses.sloka: महाखर्वसहस्राणाम् समुद्रमभिधीयते ।शतम् समुद्रसाहस्रमोघ इत्यभिधीयते ॥६-२८-३८॥।।
verses.transliteration: mahākharvasahasrāṇām samudramabhidhīyate ।śatam samudrasāhasramogha ityabhidhīyate ॥6-28-38॥।।

translations.english: A lakh of Sanku is known as Maha Sanku. A lakh of Maha Shanka is spoken as Vrinda. A lakh of Vrindas is spoken as Maha Brinda. A lakh of Maha Vrindas is known as Padma. One lakh Padmas is known as Maha Padma and a lakh of Maha Padmas is known as Kharva. A lakh of Kharvas is known as Maha Kharva and a lakh of Maha Kharvas is known as a Samudra. A lakh of Samudras is known as an Ogha. A lakh of Oghas is popularly known as Maha Ogha.
translations.hindi: सौ हजार पद्म का महापद्म और रौ हजार महापद़ा का एक खव होता है

verses.sloka: शतमोघसहस्राणाम् महौघ इति विश्रुतः ।एवम् कोटि सहस्रेण शन्कूनाम् च शतेन च ॥६-२८-३९॥।।
verses.transliteration: śatamoghasahasrāṇām mahaugha iti viśrutaḥ ।evam koṭi sahasreṇa śankūnām ca śatena ca ॥6-28-39॥।।

translations.english: "In this manner (surrounded by) thousand crore Sankhas, a hundred thousand MahaSankhas, so also by a hundred Vrindas and thousand MahaVrindas, so also by a hundred Padmas and a thousand Mahapadmas, similarly by a hundred Kharvas nay by a Samudra, and similarly by a hundred Oghas and a hundred crore MahaOghas of monkey warriors, accompanied by gallant Vibheeshana and his ministers Sugriva the king of monkeys is ever surrounded by the great army of highly valiant and strong warriors is marching to wage war.

verses.sloka: महाशङ्कुसहस्रेण तथा वृन्दशतेन च ।महावृन्दसहस्रेण तथा पद्मशतेन च ॥६-२८-४०॥।।
verses.transliteration: mahāśaṅkusahasreṇa tathā vṛndaśatena ca ।mahāvṛndasahasreṇa tathā padmaśatena ca ॥6-28-40॥।।

translations.english: "In this manner (surrounded by) thousand crore Sankhas, a hundred thousand MahaSankhas, so also by a hundred Vrindas and thousand MahaVrindas, so also by a hundred Padmas and a thousand Mahapadmas, similarly by a hundred Kharvas nay by a Samudra, and similarly by a hundred Oghas and a hundred crore MahaOghas of monkey warriors, accompanied by gallant Vibheeshana and his ministers Sugriva the king of monkeys is ever surrounded by the great army of highly valiant and strong warriors is marching to wage war.
translations.hindi: सौ हजर समुद्र का एक माघ और सौ हजार मोघ का एक महीघ होता दै

verses.sloka: महापद्मसहस्रेण तथा खर्वशतेन च ।समुद्रेण च तेनैव महुघेन तथैव च ॥६-२८-४१॥।।
verses.transliteration: mahāpadmasahasreṇa tathā kharvaśatena ca ।samudreṇa ca tenaiva mahughena tathaiva ca ॥6-28-41॥।।

translations.english: "In this manner (surrounded by) thousand crore Sankhas, a hundred thousand MahaSankhas, so also by a hundred Vrindas and thousand MahaVrindas, so also by a hundred Padmas and a thousand Mahapadmas, similarly by a hundred Kharvas nay by a Samudra, and similarly by a hundred Oghas and a hundred crore MahaOghas of monkey warriors, accompanied by gallant Vibheeshana and his ministers Sugriva the king of monkeys is ever surrounded by the great army of highly valiant and strong warriors is marching to wage war.

verses.sloka: एष कोटिमहौघेन समुद्रसदृशेन च ।विभीषणेन वीरेण सचिवैः परिवारितः ॥६-२८-४२॥।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa koṭimahaughena samudrasadṛśena ca ।vibhīṣaṇena vīreṇa sacivaiḥ parivāritaḥ ॥6-28-42॥।।

translations.english: "In this manner (surrounded by) thousand crore Sankhas, a hundred thousand MahaSankhas, so also by a hundred Vrindas and thousand MahaVrindas, so also by a hundred Padmas and a thousand Mahapadmas, similarly by a hundred Kharvas nay by a Samudra, and similarly by a hundred Oghas and a hundred crore MahaOghas of monkey warriors, accompanied by gallant Vibheeshana and his ministers Sugriva the king of monkeys is ever surrounded by the great army of highly valiant and strong warriors is marching to wage war.

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवो वानर इन्द्रस् त्वाम् युद्ध अर्थम् अभिवर्तते ।महाबलवृतो नित्यम् महाबलपराक्रमः ॥६-२८-४३॥।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvo vānara indras tvām yuddha artham abhivartate ।mahābalavṛto nityam mahābalaparākramaḥ ॥6-28-43॥।।

translations.english: "In this manner (surrounded by) thousand crore Sankhas, a hundred thousand MahaSankhas, so also by a hundred Vrindas and thousand MahaVrindas, so also by a hundred Padmas and a thousand Mahapadmas, similarly by a hundred Kharvas nay by a Samudra, and similarly by a hundred Oghas and a hundred crore MahaOghas of monkey warriors, accompanied by gallant Vibheeshana and his ministers Sugriva the king of monkeys is ever surrounded by the great army of highly valiant and strong warriors is marching to wage war.
translations.hindi: एक सौ समुद्र और एक सौ कोटि महष संख्यक बानुट्री सेना है, जो समुद्र की तरह देख पड़ती है

verses.sloka: इमाम् महाराज समीक्ष्य वाहिनीम् ।उपस्थिताम् प्रज्वलित ग्रह उपमाम् ।ततः प्रयत्नः परमो विधीयताम् ।यथा जयः स्यान् न परैः पराजयः ॥६-२८-४४॥
verses.transliteration: imām mahārāja samīkṣya vāhinīm ।upasthitām prajvalita graha upamām ।tataḥ prayatnaḥ paramo vidhīyatām ।yathā jayaḥ syān na paraiḥ parājayaḥ ॥6-28-44॥

translations.english: "O Great King! Observing the ocean of army close by their appearing cruel like a blazing planet, make supreme efforts to be victorious and not to be defeated in the hands of the enemy." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टाविंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty eighth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: महाबलबृतो नित्यं महाबलपराक्रमः। ४४.॥ 5 २४० युद्धकाण्डे इतनी बढी वानरी सेना तथा सचिवों सहित विभीषण को साथ लिए हुए कापराज सुग्रीव, आपसे लड़ने को उपस्थित हुए हैं । वानरेन्द्र के साथ बड़ी भारी सेना है ; जो बड़ी बलवान्‌ और पराक्रमी है
